The '''UniSlice''' was a security code breaker developed and manufactured by [[Duwani Mechanical Products/Legends|Duwani Mechanical Products]]. At a price of 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the UniSlice was designed to infiltrate the electronic hardware of [[Lock/Legends|locks]].<ref name="TotJC" />
